using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

void traverseCycle(bool visited[], long long start, int multiplier, int modulus) {
    long long current = start;
    while (!visited[current]) {
        visited[current] = true;
        current = (current * multiplier) % modulus;
    }
}

int main() {
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    long long result = 1;
    if (k == 1) {
        result = p;
    } else {
        memset(visited, false, sizeof(visited));
        for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
            if (!visited[i]) {
                traverseCycle(visited, i, k, p);
                result = (result * p) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << result << endl;
    return 0;
